# datasink Extended Technical Spec

> Accurate reference for AI agents and humans. Only endpoints and behaviours that exist in production are documented here.

## Overview

`datasink` (npm package name; CLI binary `sink`) cleans music PR contact lists through four phases: `scrub` → `rinse` → `soak` → `steep`.

Repo: https://github.com/chrisschouk/sink-cli  
Demo: https://datasink.dev  
Install: `npx datasink scrub contacts.csv`

---

## Pipeline phases

### Scrub

- RFC-style email format checks, normalisation, UK domain typo correction
- Disposable domain detection, role-based mailbox tagging (`press@`, `info@`, …)
- MX verification (Node `dns` in CLI; Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS in browser — domains only)

### Rinse

- Exact email dedup (case-insensitive, keeps richer record)
- Fuzzy name match (Jaro-Winkler, default threshold 0.92) within the same domain
- Cross-field match by phone across different emails

### Soak

- LLM enrichment (platform type, genre, geo, submission tips)
- Providers: Anthropic or OpenAI via env keys / web BYOK panel
- Silently skipped when no key is present

### Steep

- Scrapes outlet public pages (via Firecrawl) and extracts channels, portals, presenters, pitch hooks
- Needs `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` plus an LLM key; skipped when missing
- Web demo proxies Firecrawl through `/api/firecrawl-proxy` because of CORS

---

## HTTP endpoints that exist

### GET /api/health

```bash
curl -s https://datasink.dev/api/health
# {"status":"ok","version":"0.4.1","service":"datasink"}
```

### POST /api/firecrawl-proxy

Body JSON: `{ "url": "https://example.com", "firecrawlKey": "fc-..." }`  
Returns scraped markdown. The key is used once and not stored.

There is **no** hosted `/api/mcp`, OAuth server, or agent registration API.

---

## CLI quick reference

```bash
npx datasink demo                 # sample data, no file needed
npx datasink scrub contacts.csv
npx datasink rinse contacts.csv
npx datasink wash contacts.csv    # full pipeline
npx datasink spot name@outlet.co.uk
npx datasink inspect contacts.csv
```

Global flags include `-o/--output`, `--format`, `--dry-run`, `--provider`, `--verbose`, `--json`.

---

## Browser / WebMCP

On datasink.dev, if the browser exposes `navigator.modelContext`, the page registers a `scrub_contacts` helper. That is in-page WebMCP only — not a remote MCP HTTP server.

---

## Discovery files

- `/.well-known/api-catalog` — RFC 9727 linkset for the real API surface
- `/.well-known/ai-plugin.json` — OpenAI plugin-style manifest (auth: none)
- `/.well-known/agent-skills/` — skill markdown for agents
- `/.well-known/security.txt` — vulnerability contact
- `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt` — this documentation
- `/auth.md` — BYOK notes (no OAuth)
